reason: A terminal-management plugin that provides a command and session-header button to close persistent bash sessions so the sandbox mode can be switched.

summaries.zh: 提供“退出 Bash”命令和会话头部按钮，用于关闭持久 Bash 终端并支持切换沙箱模式。
summaries.en: Provides an /exit-bash command and session-header button to close persistent Bash terminals before switching sandbox modes.

capabilities: Adds a session-header button to invoke the command
Sends exit to persistent bash shells
Kills terminal sessions and aborts pending terminal creation
Can terminate an active bash tool call
